This is not proof of fraud.","redFlags":["Requests a refundable registration fee of ₹3,500 before providing an offer letter.","Pressures the recipient to pay today.","Promises a work-from-home role without describing the interview or selection process."],"positiveSignals":[],"recommendedActions":["Do not pay the fee or send money, gift cards, or cryptocurrency.","Do not share passwords, OTPs, banking credentials, or card details.","Contact the company using independently located official contact information."],"thingsToVerify":["Whether the company lists this role on its official careers site.","Whether the recruiter works for the company, using an official company email or phone number.","Whether any interview and hiring process is described on the company's official site."]}
